description:
FILED s414 (Opus) â exactly the census-as-bug-finder case: the copies of one
rule disagreed, and the sibling that disagreed was the bug.

In Pl/ExprToCL.pm's gen_funcall_form, the a_acc / h_acc arms of `tied` and
`pos` call `_swap_elem_sigil($container_form, '@'|'%')` UNCONDITIONALLY,
while the arms of `delete` and `exists` only do so when the container NODE is
a bare PPI::Token::Symbol or ::Magic.  That guard is not cosmetic: commit
ac6fdc1 (2026-06-07, "package-var subscript sigils") added it because
`_swap_elem_sigil`'s `s/(^|::)\$/$1SIGIL/` is unanchored and also rewrites a
package-qualified index INSIDE the container's already-generated text.

PROBED (emission, s414):
  package Pkg; our @a = ({k=>"aXbXc"}); our $i = 1; our $k = "k";
  pos($a[$i]{$k})     ->  (p-pos    (p-gethash-box (p-aref @a Pkg::%i) Pkg::$k))
  tied($a[$i]{$k})    ->  (p-tied   (p-gethash-box (p-aref @a Pkg::%i) Pkg::$k))
  exists($a[$i]{$k})  ->  (p-exists (p-aref @a Pkg::$i) Pkg::$k)      <- correct
`Pkg::%i` is a different variable (the hash %i), so the index reads undef ->
element 0.  It is a WRONG-VARIABLE reference, not a formatting slip.

Currently MASKED, which is why no test caught it: pos() on an element is
always undef anyway (task #396) and `tie $a[0], ...` is unimplemented (#155),
so neither consumer can show the difference in output today.  It becomes
observable the moment either is fixed.

FIX: unify all four arms on ONE `_elem_container_key($arg_id)` helper that
carries the GUARDED rule (#387 family 2's extraction).  Emission changes for
tied/pos on a nested package-qualified access only.


DONE s414 (`s414b` d33c5a1) by the family-2 extraction: all four arms now ask ExprToCL::_elem_container_key, which carries the guarded rule once.  Guard rows: three shape assertions in Pl/t/transpile-test-10.t (pos/tied keep Pkg::$i, and no arm emits Pkg::%i) -- they FAIL on the pre-change tree, verified in a HEAD worktree.  Corpus emission IDENTICAL, so nothing in perl-tests or lib carries the shape; the sweep is +0.
subject: The `tied`/`pos` funcall arms mis-sigil a nested package-qualified INDEX (emit `Pkg::%i` for `Pkg::$i`) â ac6fdc1 guarded exists/delete in June and never propagated to the twins (#387 family 2)
